method.quote_sampling: At each whole-second boundary, use book messages strictly earlier than that boundary. Reset on snapshots, replace level size on updates, remove zero sizes. Carry quote across idle seconds and retain book message age. No crossed-book repair.
method.coverage: All filenames inventoried; content audited in six chosen hours across all three markets. Not a full corpus integrity scan.
method.working_tree: Existing local modifications inspected; left unchanged.
